articles.title: From music to mind reading: AI startups bet on earbuds
articles.mainIdea: From music to mind reading: AI startups bet on earbuds
articles.summary: AFP: From music to mind reading: AI startups bet on earbuds. AI companies are on the hunt to design the ideal device to deliver AI's superpowers, and some new enterprises are convinced that headphones or earbuds are the way.That's the opportunity for our earbuds," explained Shawn Ma, CEO of Viaim, whose devices are compatible with all brands, including iPhones in China.

articles.title: SiriusXM to Report Fourth Quarter and Full-Year 2025 Operating and Financial Results
articles.mainIdea: SiriusXM to Report Fourth Quarter and Full-Year 2025 Operating and Financial Results
articles.summary: PR Newswire: SiriusXM to Report Fourth Quarter and Full-Year 2025 Operating and Financial Results. SiriusXM (NASDAQ: SIRI) will release its fourth quarter and full-year 2025 operating and financial results on Thursday, February 5, and will hold an investor call that same day at 8:00 a.m. ET. A live webcast of the call will be available on the SiriusXM Investor Relations website at https://investor.siriusxm.com.
